how_to_price_a_new_model: 1. The runtime price source is a LiteLLM-format catalog, not a DB table: data_dir/model_prices_and_context_window.json, refreshed from pricing.remote_url.
2. Precedence when resolving a model: group.model_pricing -> channel_model_pricing -> LiteLLM catalog -> hardcoded fallback in billing_service.go.
3. Nothing strips model-name suffixes, so an alias like 'gemini-4-argon-gcp' needs its own resolution - either its own catalog key or a Contains-based matcher in the fallback.
4. Editing data_dir/model_prices_and_context_window.json is futile: the 10-minute sync job overwrites it. Use pricing.override_file (highest precedence, never overwritten) for a no-code fix.
5. Historical usage_logs keep the cost computed at the time - fixing a price does NOT rewrite past records.

6. Since 0.2.17 upstream ships official cards for new Gemini models (gemini-4-argon, gemini-4-argon-cyber-permissive, grok-4.7-fast) in the fallback table itself. After a sync, diff our entry against upstream's before keeping ours: prefer their published rates, keep only genuinely additive fields (e.g. our CacheCreation) and our alias matchers.

Gemini-boundary tail normalization for converted generateContent requests: appends a minimal user turn when the history would end with a model turn, and splits a trailing user turn that mixes a functionResponse with *text*. Both shapes are rejected by Gemini 3.6+/4.x (Vertex: `400 Requests ending with a model turn are not supported.`), and both were confirmed by probing Vertex directly. Called from one place: convertClaudeMessagesToGeminiGenerateContent (overlay OVR-016), so it covers the chat completions, messages, Responses and Antigravity compat chains at once. 2026-10-22 sync: only text parts are split out now - upstream 0.2.17 preserves tool-result images as inlineData in the same turn (a supported multimodal shape), and the old catch-all split undid that feature.
